create_courier_game: create a CourierGame instance with a config dict for a StreetLearn courier navigation environment
run_courier_game_reset: run the on_reset method to select a random goal pano and reset episode statistics
test_get_reward: test the get_reward method to compute reward based on distance to goal and coin collection

summarize_compute_spl: summarize the _compute_spl_current_goal method that calculates success weighted by inverse path length
